product_overview: SASE-310-SYSTEM es un sistema institucional escolar para acompañamiento operativo: onboarding progresivo 30/60/90, registro de incidencias y expedientes, y operación por rol con trazabilidad y notificaciones.
core_goals: Garantizar acceso seguro y resolución de roles consistente (profiles_usuario con fallback legacy).
Aplicar onboarding progresivo 30/60/90 para reducir la complejidad para usuarios nuevos.
Proveer tableros y acciones rápidas (Reporte Rápido / Detección Pedagógica) para docentes en Fase 1.
Permitir registro y aprobación controlada de personal mediante funciones de backend seguras.
Registrar incidencias operativas y mantener un semáforo de riesgo persistido en SQL.
Mantener trazabilidad y generación documental para expedientes institucionales.
Soportar proxies de IA y notificaciones (WhatsApp) con auditoría y validación de roles.

features.name: autenticacion_y_roles
features.description: Inicio de sesión con Supabase, obtención de perfil y resolución de rol (profiles_usuario con fallback a profiles).
user_flows: POST /api/auth/signin with valid credentials -> Receive 200 with JWT token -> GET /api/users/me with Authorization: Bearer <token> -> Receive 200 with profile including role 'docente' and created_at
POST /api/auth/signin with invalid credentials -> Receive 401 unauthorized -> POST /api/auth/resend-mfa or /api/auth/help -> Receive 429 or 400 (rate/invalid) as applicable

features.name: onboarding_30_60_90
features.description: Cálculo de fase de onboarding (Fase 1: 0-30d, Fase 2: 31-60d, Fase 3: >=61d) y restricciones de visibilidad de módulos en sidebar según rol y antigüedad.
user_flows: GET /api/users/me with Authorization: Bearer <token> -> Receive 200 with created_at within 0-30 days -> GET /api/onboarding/phase?user_id=<id> -> Receive 200 { phase: 1 } -> GET /api/sidebar?role=docente&phase=1 -> Receive 200 menu list containing ['Tablero','Asistencia','Detección Pedagógica'] and not containing ['Expedientes','Agenda','Incidencias','Protocolos']

GET /api/users/me with Authorization: Bearer <token> -> Receive 200 but missing created_at -> GET /api/onboarding/phase?user_id=<id> -> Receive 500 server error -> GET /api/sidebar?fallback=true -> Receive 200 minimal safe menu ['Tablero','Asistencia'] (UI should use safe fallback)

features.name: dashboards_por_rol
features.description: Tableros diferenciados por rol con acciones rápidas dentro del dashboard docente (ej. Reporte Rápido) y protección de accesos no correspondientes al rol.
user_flows: GET /api/dashboards/docente with Authorization: Bearer <token> -> Receive 200 dashboard payload including quick_actions ['Reporte Rápido'] -> POST /api/incidencias/quick-register with Authorization: Bearer <token> and incidence payload -> Receive 201 with incidence_id

GET /api/dashboards/director with Authorization: Bearer <docente_token> -> Receive 403 forbidden -> GET /api/dashboards/docente with Authorization: Bearer <docente_token> -> Receive 200 (confirm role-scoped access)

features.name: registro_y_aprobacion_de_personal
features.description: Solicitud pública de alta de personal y aprobación segura por un proceso backend (edge function approve-staff).
user_flows: POST /api/staff/apply with applicant data (public) -> Receive 201 application_id -> GET /api/staff/applications/{application_id} with admin token -> Receive 200 pending application

POST /supabase/functions/approve-staff with admin Authorization: Bearer <admin_token> and body { application_id } -> Receive 200 approval_result -> POST /supabase/functions/approve-staff with non-admin token -> Receive 403 forbidden

features.name: incidencias_y_semaforo
features.description: Registro operativo rápido de incidencias desde el dashboard y persistencia del semáforo de riesgo en SQL con consulta por estudiante.
user_flows: POST /api/incidencias/quick-register with Authorization: Bearer <token> and minimal incidence payload -> Receive 201 { incidence_id } -> GET /api/semaphore/student/{student_id} with Authorization: Bearer <token> -> Receive 200 { risk_level } (risk updated accordingly)

POST /api/incidencias/quick-register with Authorization: Bearer <token> and malformed payload (missing required fields) -> Receive 400 validation error -> POST /api/incidencias/quick-register with corrected payload -> Receive 201

features.name: expedientes_y_documentos
features.description: Consulta institucional de expedientes, timeline y generación documental con trazabilidad; acceso controlado por fase/onboarding y rol.
user_flows: GET /api/expedientes/{student_id} with Authorization: Bearer <token> and user in Fase 2+ -> Receive 200 expediente timeline -> POST /api/documentos/generate with Authorization: Bearer <token> and { expediente_id, template_id } -> Receive 201 document_id and audit record

GET /api/expedientes/{student_id} with Authorization: Bearer <token> and user in Fase 1 -> Receive 403 forbidden (Expedientes hidden/blocked) -> GET /api/expedientes/{student_id} with Authorization: Bearer <admin_token> -> Receive 200 (admin override)

features.name: protocolos_y_agenda
features.description: Acceso a protocolos institucionales y agenda operativa escolar con búsqueda por fecha y control por rol.
user_flows: GET /api/protocols with Authorization: Bearer <token> -> Receive 200 list of protocols -> GET /api/agenda?date=2026-04-05 with Authorization: Bearer <token> -> Receive 200 events for date

GET /api/protocols without Authorization header -> Receive 401 unauthorized -> POST /api/auth/signin with valid admin credentials -> Receive 200 token -> GET /api/protocols with admin token -> Receive 200

features.name: ia_y_notificaciones
features.description: Proxies de IA para generación/ayuda y notificaciones (WhatsApp) con validación de rol, logging y auditoría de las acciones.
user_flows: POST /api/ai/summarize with Authorization: Bearer <token> and { text } -> Receive 200 { summary, audit_id } -> POST /api/notifications/whatsapp with Authorization: Bearer <token> and { audit_id, phone, message } -> Receive 200 { message_id, status:'sent' }

POST /api/notifications/whatsapp with Authorization: Bearer <token_of_role_without_permission> and { phone, message } -> Receive 403 forbidden -> POST /api/notifications/whatsapp with admin token and same payload -> Receive 200 { message_id }
